consentModal.title: Save your hotdog history?
consentModal.description: We'd like to set one cookie that keeps your photos and verdicts in this browser so you can look back later. Say no and everything still works — we just won't save anything. No tracking, no ads.

preferencesModal.title: Cookie settings
preferencesModal.essentialDescription: Remembers your cookie choice (cc_cookie). Always on.
preferencesModal.historyDescription: Keeps your photos and verdicts in this browser (hotdog_or_not_visitor_session). Turning it off erases everything we've saved.
preferencesModal.deleteDescription: Use “Delete my data” at the bottom of the page anytime.
